Checkpoint and Catalog Persistence
|-- [M] Checkpoint codec: expanded canvas state <-> immutable record graph
|   |-- Public boundary
|   |   |-- CanvasCheckpointEncoder.encode -> checkpoints + items + optional head reference map
|   |   `-- restoreCanvasCheckpoints / loadCanvasCheckpoint -> expanded snapshots
|   |-- Private encoding machinery
|   |   |-- Split independently edited objects; parent skeletons retain ordering
|   |   |-- CanvasValueEncoder hashes serialized items with SHA-256
|   |   |   `-- sourceAscii and strings >= 512 characters become shared text items
|   |   `-- Compare record-reference maps -> added / updated / removed references
|   |       |-- Parent delta depth < 31 -> use parent as base; depth increases by one
|   |       `-- Otherwise -> full reference-map checkpoint at depth 0
|   |           `-- Logical parentId remains; replay baseId is omitted
|   |-- [D] One restored checkpoint needs
|   |   |-- Checkpoint identity and metadata
|   |   |-- Record-reference map
|   |   |   |-- Supplied head map -> direct lookup without replaying ancestors
|   |   |   `-- Otherwise -> base checkpoint references + checked deltas
|   |   |       `-- At most 31 delta links; reject cycles, invalid depths and conflicts
|   |   `-- Referenced value items -> referenced text items
|   |       `-- Fill validated placeholders -> original document, view and bindings
|   `-- [O] Encoder retains known items and encoded checkpoint maps
|       |-- Incremental output drains pending items; full output includes all known items
|       `-- Restore may reuse snapshots while checkpoint and dependency objects remain identical
|
|-- [M] Browser workspace persistence: live owners -> incremental storage changes
|   |-- WorkspacePersistence exposes sync / update / pause / dispose
|   |   |-- Depends on session persistenceChanges(cursor), source-pane view and RecordStorage
|   |   |-- Keeps per-session cursors and known drafts private
|   |   `-- [C] Workspace or view notification -> project changed records -> storage.batch
|   |       |-- Workspace index: document IDs, active document and cross-canvas transfers
|   |       |-- Per-document metadata, saved baseline, history header and viewport
|   |       |-- Checkpoint deltas + exact diagram revisions + shared items
|   |       |-- Current view encoded separately, sharing content-addressed items with history
|   |       `-- Deduplicate keys and omit already stored items
|   |           |-- Removed document -> delete its record keys
|   |           `-- New session replacing a graph -> remove obsolete checkpoints/revisions
|   |               `-- Replacement and removals enter the same batch
|   |-- RecordStorage exposes get / batch / flush / commit / status
|   |   `-- Transport boundary: write({requestId, expectedRevision, changes}) -> {revision}
|   |       `-- Encoding and transport are supplied externally; cache and queue stay private
|   |-- [C] Ordinary autosave
|   |   |-- batch -> update local cache; skip equal values; coalesce pending changes by key
|   |   |-- Schedule after 150 ms by default, capped by 1 s of pending age
|   |   `-- pump -> create one in-flight batch -> transport.write
|   |       |-- Acknowledged -> advance revision and persisted sequence; clear flight
|   |       |   `-- Later edits remain pending for the next batch
|   |       `-- Failed -> retain identical batch and requestId
|   |           |-- Transient failure -> exponential retry delay, capped at 30 s
|   |           `-- REJECTED / VERSION_CONFLICT / REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |               `-- Stop automatic background scheduling
|   |-- [C] Explicit commit
|   |   |-- Flush earlier edits -> retain prior cache -> submit transaction -> await acknowledgement
|   |   |-- REJECTED -> restore prior cache and discard abandoned queued transaction
|   |   `-- Other failure -> retry identical request every 500 ms until success or disposal
|   |       `-- UI installs explicit transactions only after acknowledgement
|   `-- [O] Browser bridge owns subscriptions; RecordStorage owns cache, queue and timer
|       |-- WorkspacePersistence.dispose -> unsubscribe
|       `-- RecordStorage.dispose -> clear timer and listeners
|           `-- Caller must flush before orderly close; abrupt tab exit has no flush guarantee
|
|-- [M] WorkspaceRecordStore: validated batches -> durable workspace manifest
|   |-- Public boundary: state / load / apply / replace / capture / viewHeaders
|   |   |-- Depends on workspace record validation and checkpoint restoration
|   |   `-- Private manifest maps logical record keys to immutable blob hashes
|   |       `-- Also retains workspace revision and request receipts
|   |-- [C] apply(batch), serialized through a process-local queue keyed by store root
|   |   |-- Check request shape; read current manifest and records
|   |   |-- Look up receipt before checking expectedRevision
|   |   |   |-- Same requestId + same batch hash -> return recorded revision
|   |   |   `-- Same requestId + different hash -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |   |-- No receipt + stale expectedRevision -> VERSION_CONFLICT
|   |   |-- Apply changes to candidate records; reject duplicate keys
|   |   |   |-- Existing diagram revisions and content-addressed items cannot change
|   |   |   `-- Checkpoints may be re-encoded only if semantic state remains unchanged
|   |   |       `-- transactionId is excluded from that immutability comparison
|   |   |-- validateRecordUpdate -> validate affected histories, presentation and references
|   |   |   `-- Transfers require both participants and before/after checkpoints
|   |   |       `-- Destination links transactionId; moves also require the source link
|   |   `-- publish(candidate revision + receipt + record references)
|   |       |-- Write changed blobs by content hash, with at most 8 concurrent writers
|   |       |   `-- Temporary file -> write -> fsync -> close -> rename
|   |       |-- Await every writer, including after a writer fails
|   |       |-- Sync blob directory before publishing references
|   |       `-- Atomically replace and sync manifest -> all batch changes become reachable
|   |           `-- Ambiguous publication failure -> retry same ID to discover durable receipt
|   |-- [D] Checkpoint capture for publication needs one pinned manifest
|   |   |-- History header.headId == requested checkpointId
|   |   |-- Metadata.version == requested version
|   |   |-- Selected checkpoint + referenced items -> expanded head
|   |   `-- Head's exact revision IDs -> bound diagram revisions
|   |       `-- Return expanded head plus pinned references to checkpoint/revision/item records
|   |-- Lightweight read boundary: viewHeaders
|   |   `-- Workspace index + each document's metadata/history header; no checkpoint archive read
|   `-- [O] Manifest owns reachability; blob contents remain immutable
|       |-- Deleting a record removes its manifest reference
|       |-- Failed publication can leave unreachable blobs; no blob garbage collection shown
|       `-- File handles close and temporary files are removed in finally blocks
|
|-- [M] CanvasCatalogStore: composition and publication boundary
|   |-- Exposes checkpoint publication, multi-canvas acceptance, catalog reads and archiving
|   |   |-- Depends on catalog rules, history service and DiagramPersistence
|   |   `-- Private promise chain serializes operations within this store instance
|   |-- [C] publishCheckpoint(input, captureCheckpoint)
|   |   |-- Existing request receipt -> return it if signature matches; otherwise conflict
|   |   |-- Existing target must be settled and match expectedRevisionId
|   |   |-- Invoke captureCheckpoint -> obtain persisted checkpoint and pinned references
|   |   |-- Validate repository ownership; apply publication rules
|   |   `-- Atomic catalog replacement publishes new revision reference + retry receipt
|   |       `-- Reuses autosaved immutable records; does not hydrate old catalog revisions
|   |-- [C] acceptCanvasChanges
|   |   |-- Matching prior acceptance -> return receipt
|   |   |-- Require distinct documents and targets; check each expected published revision
|   |   |-- New target -> fork proposed history; existing target -> adopt into saved history
|   |   |-- Build candidate catalog and before/after checkpoint receipt for every document
|   |   `-- saveRepresentationCatalog -> persist backing records -> atomic catalog replacement
|   |       `-- All new heads and acceptance receipt become visible together
|   |           `-- Failure before replacement publishes none of the candidate canvases
|   |-- Other catalog publications
|   |   |-- Output promotion -> group membership + canvases + retry receipt in one replacement
|   |   `-- Archive -> change catalog metadata while retaining encoded history references
|   `-- [O] Catalog owns published heads and receipts; immutable stores retain backing content
|       `-- Workspace manifest publication and catalog publication are separate commit boundaries
|
`-- [M] DiagramPersistence and immutable storage: portable documents <-> stored references
    |-- Public adapter contract: persist / restore / currentHistory / sourceBindings
    |   |-- DiagramRecordStore exposes put(kind, data) -> hash and get(kind, hash) -> data
    |   |-- Kinds: diagram, revision, history, workspace
    |   `-- Encoded references remain a storage detail; public documents remain expanded
    |-- [C] persist(history)
    |   |-- Validate history -> persist diagrams -> persist revisions referencing diagrams
    |   |-- Encode checkpoints and shared items -> persist history archive
    |   `-- Return header + checkpoint deltas + head map + archive reference
    |       `-- Catalog publishes these references only after persistence completes
    |-- [D] Current published canvas needs
    |   |-- Catalog representation.currentRevisionId -> stored canvas history
    |   |-- History head -> selected checkpoint record graph described above
    |   `-- Checkpoint's exact revision bindings -> revision records -> diagram records
    |       |-- currentHistory -> validate and register bound revisions; return one-head history
    |       |-- Saved/recording canvas views present -> restore wider graph they may reference
    |       `-- sourceBindings -> read bound diagrams' source metadata and deduplicate bindings
    |-- [C] Full restore
    |   `-- Resolve references -> rebuild checkpoints -> validate history -> register revisions
    |       `-- Coalesce record reads; return cloned hydrated records
    |-- DiagramRevisionStore implements DiagramRecordStore
    |   |-- put -> hash JSON; verify existing bytes or write temporary file and rename
    |   |-- get -> verify SHA-256 before parsing
    |   `-- Workspace references resolve into the same workspace blob directory used above
    `-- [O] Independent ImmutableRecords utility
        |-- put/get retain immutable JSON blobs addressed by SHA-256
        |-- publishJson -> sync temporary file -> rename -> sync directory; always close/clean up
        |-- Private cache retains at most 256 entries and 32 MiB; oversized items are not cached
        `-- Pinned workspace/catalog implementations do not show calls to this utility
